What should an experience gift voucher tell the recipient?

Name the experience in terms the recipient will understand. Include the provider, who the gift is for, how many guests it covers and where to choose a date. Enter a redemption code already issued by your store or booking provider. Use a photo that shows the actual experience, then review the printed voucher and redemption link together before sending it.

Sell bookable experiences on Shopify →

Worked example

A family buys a sunset kayak tour for two. The voucher names both the activity and the guest count, carries a note from the family and links directly to the provider’s kayak-tour booking page. The provider’s existing code handles redemption.

Experience Gift Voucher Maker FAQ

Does the maker create a Shopify gift card balance?

It designs the voucher customers receive. Create or obtain the redeemable code in your store or booking system first, then enter that code in the design.

Can I use a photo of my own class or activity?

Yes. Upload a cover photo or choose a supplied design. A landscape image with the main subject near the middle gives you room for cropping.

Can the recipient choose a date later?

Use a booking link that lets the recipient select an available date. The gift design itself does not reserve a particular session or hold a seat.

What if the gift is for two people or for a specific package?

Write the entitlement in the experience name, such as “Afternoon ceramics for two.” Check the issued code or booking credit covers the same offer.

How do I send a digital copy?

Choose Print / save PDF and save the voucher from the print preview. Send that file privately to the purchaser or recipient because it contains the redemption code.

Can I print a sample to display at the counter?

Yes. Use a sample code and a fictional recipient for display. Enter the actual code and personal message only in the copy intended for the gift recipient.
